resources.string: Back up → copy to PC or USB → clean flash → copy back → restore.
Choose a folder in Documents or on a USB drive.
Synced contacts return through their account. RCS chats and live wallpapers are outside this backup format.
Copy this whole folder to PC or USB before wiping. Copy it back and choose the folder to find your snapshots.
Delete this backup file? This cannot be undone.
The backup folder is unavailable. Reconnect the drive or choose the folder again.

Every snapshot uses password-based AES-256-GCM encryption. Keep the password separately: a clean flash removes local settings, but the password still unlocks the archive. No account or network connection is needed.

Selected user apps close briefly while HeckerOS saves their private files. This also supports apps whose Android backup agent returns no data. Signing certificates and versions are checked on restore. Protected system apps use Android backup agents when supported.
Allow Android app-data backups? HeckerVault temporarily selects its local transport during a backup. Your previous backup provider is restored afterwards, when available.
Uses the current selections, folder and saved Vault encryption password. Runs after device unlock. Keep the original password for recovery after a clean flash.
Android could not update the schedule.

Internal owner profile only. APKs and splits are included. Private files of selected user apps are captured even when their Android backup agent provides no data. Cache, links, notification channels, device identifiers and hardware Keystore keys are excluded. Some apps need login or setup again. Personal data is merged; private app data is replaced on restore. Swift import remains deferred.
A backup operation is running. Wait or cancel it first.
Select apps or personal data first.
Keep this password separately for recovery after a clean flash. You can reset it on this phone using your screen lock.
Confirm it is you before accessing backup data.
HeckerVault could not start. Check that the matching ROM is installed.

Restore these selected items? App data may replace current data. Shared storage files with matching paths will be replaced. Contacts, SMS, MMS and call history are merged. Installed apps with different signing certificates are rejected.
This archive could not be prepared for restore.
App group saved with your current personal-data selections.
Use a group name of 1–40 characters and a valid selection.
Select some apps, then save your first group.
Use this group’s apps and personal-data selections?
